facts.text: Pasta first, then the race. If we win the Portorosso Cup, Alberto gets his scooter.
facts.why: Giulia doesn't say this. The Cup runs swim, pasta, then bike, so pasta is not first. The boys want a Vespa together and win it as a team, so it isn't just Alberto's scooter.

vibe.verdict: A sweet harbour cafe with the right food and the Cup as a running idea, and the colours suit the film.
missing: Massimo and the fishing boat (Marcovaldo home)
Luca's diving suit in the swim leg (Portorosso Cup)
Alberto's marks on the lighthouse wall
ideas: Swap 'Lemon ricotta cake' for a gelato scoop named after the boys' first taste of gelato.
Swap 'Pesto pasta with potato and green beans' note for the pasta-eating leg, named as the Cup plate.
Add a Massimo's fish dinner to replace 'Riviera fish, prawn and mussel stew' note.
Swap 'Chinotto on ice' note for Machiavelli stealing fish.
